chapter_name: C系列迷你回顧＋情境模擬

sentences.en: Good evening! I have a reservation under Wu — W-U.
sentences.tips: 「I have a reservation」是提示對方你已預訂，「I'd like to book」是現在要預訂，兩者場合不同。

sentences.en: That's right. And if possible, I'd love a room on a higher floor — maybe with a city view?
sentences.zh: 沒錯。如果可以的話，我希望住高樓層，最好有城市景觀？
sentences.tips: 旅遊英文中，語氣禮貌比文法完美更重要，配合微笑與耐心，大多數情況都能順利溝通。

sentences.en: Sure. Here's my passport, and here's my Visa card. Also — could I get a wake-up call at 7 a.m. tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 好的，護照和Visa卡給您。另外，明天早上7點可以幫我叫醒嗎？
sentences.tips: 旅遊英文中，語氣禮貌比文法完美更重要，配合微笑與耐心，大多數情況都能順利溝通。

sentences.en: Hi, this is room 1208. The air conditioning in my room isn't working — it keeps making a loud noise.
sentences.zh: 你好，這是1208房。我的冷氣壞了，一直發出很大的聲音。
sentences.tips: 旅遊英文中，語氣禮貌比文法完美更重要，配合微笑與耐心，大多數情況都能順利溝通。

sentences.en: I'd prefer to move, if that's possible. I have an early start tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的話，我想換房，我明天要早起。
sentences.tips: 旅遊英文中，語氣禮貌比文法完美更重要，配合微笑與耐心，大多數情況都能順利溝通。

sentences.en: That's great, thank you. Also — could you send up some extra towels to the new room?
sentences.zh: 太好了，謝謝。另外，可以送幾條毛巾到新房間嗎？
sentences.tips: 感謝對方時，Thank you 較正式，Thanks 較口語，旅行中兩者都很常用，可靈活選用。

sentences.en: Excuse me — where's the self-service laundry room? And do I need coins?
sentences.zh: 請問自助洗衣間在哪裡？需要硬幣嗎？
sentences.tips: 「Excuse me」用於禮貌打擾或吸引注意；「Sorry」則是道歉，兩者場合不同，注意區分。

sentences.en: Great — could I have change for a five-pound note?
sentences.zh: 好的，可以幫我把5英鎊換成硬幣嗎？
sentences.tips: 「Can I have...?」是請求某物的常用句型，「Could I have...?」語氣更委婉正式。

sentences.en: Excuse me — I put in two pounds but machine number 4 won't start. I think it might be broken.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，我放了兩英鎊但4號機器不啟動，我想它可能壞了。
sentences.tips: 「Excuse me」用於禮貌打擾或吸引注意；「Sorry」則是道歉，兩者場合不同，注意區分。

sentences.en: Hi — I hate to complain, but this is the second afternoon my room still hasn't been cleaned. It's already 4 p.m.
sentences.zh: 你好，我不太想抱怨，但今天是第二個下午，我的房間到下午4點都還沒打掃。
sentences.tips: 旅遊英文中，語氣禮貌比文法完美更重要，配合微笑與耐心，大多數情況都能順利溝通。

sentences.en: I appreciate that. I've had a few issues this stay — the air conditioning, and now this. I'd also like to discuss some form of compensation when I check out.
sentences.zh: 感謝，這次住宿遇到了一些問題，冷氣還有現在這個，退房時我想討論一下補償的事。
sentences.tips: 英式英語用 bill，美式英語用 check 指帳單，兩者皆通用。結帳時說 Can I have the bill/check, please?

sentences.en: Good morning — I'd like to check out. Room 1208.
sentences.tips: 「I'd like to...」是比「I want to...」更禮貌的請求方式，在服務場合使用更顯得有禮貌。

sentences.en: I appreciate that. Is that the best you're able to do? There were quite a few disruptions over three nights.
sentences.zh: 感謝，這已經是你們最好的方案了嗎？三晚發生了相當多的狀況。
sentences.tips: 旅遊英文中，語氣禮貌比文法完美更重要，配合微笑與耐心，大多數情況都能順利溝通。

sentences.en: That's very reasonable — thank you. I'll pay the £389 by card. And could I get a receipt by email?
sentences.zh: 這很合理，謝謝。我刷卡付389英鎊，可以用電子郵件寄收據嗎？
sentences.tips: 感謝對方時，Thank you 較正式，Thanks 較口語，旅行中兩者都很常用，可靈活選用。

sentences.en: Hello — I'd like to book a table for two this evening at 7, if you have availability.
sentences.zh: 你好，我想訂今晚7點兩位，如果有位置的話。
sentences.tips: 「I'd like to...」是比「I want to...」更禮貌的請求方式，在服務場合使用更顯得有禮貌。

sentences.en: Wu — W-U. Also, one of us has a shellfish allergy — could the kitchen flag that?
sentences.zh: 吳，W-U。另外，我們其中一位對甲殼類過敏，廚房可以備注嗎？
sentences.tips: 在餐廳點餐時，若有飲食限制務必清楚說明，I'm allergic to... 或 I'm vegetarian 能有效溝通需求。

sentences.en: That would be lovely — thank you!
sentences.tips: 感謝對方時，Thank you 較正式，Thanks 較口語，旅行中兩者都很常用，可靈活選用。

multiple_choice.question: 下列哪一句英文的意思是「晚安！我有訂房，名字吳，W-U。」？
